quests.title: Lantern Night
quests.summary: A wounded courier, a stolen letter, and three strangers who want it back.

steps.text: Speak with Brannoc, the innkeeper
See to the wounded courier (Medicine)
Find out who wants the courier's letter

quests.title: The Old Mine
quests.summary: Someone is digging in the old mine. The road there runs through goblin country, and Grisk Two-Teeth holds the missing miners.

steps.text: Take the Ashford road toward the old mine (F2)
Get past the goblin warren's gate (F3)
Deal with Grisk Two-Teeth (F4: fight, sneak or trade)
Bring the missing miners out of the warren
Get past the diggers at the mine mouth (F5)
Cross the Deep Seam (F6)
Find the way into the old Ammarindar halls
Face Brother Ulric in the sunken shrine (F7)
Climb back to the mine mouth with the shard

quests.title: Something in the Cellar
quests.summary: Brannoc has heard scratching under the floorboards for a week.

steps.text: Ask Brannoc about the scratching
Clear Brannoc's cellar
Follow the old tunnel under the cellar

quests.title: The Herbalist's Granddaughter
quests.summary: Old Wynn's granddaughter Tamsin has gone into the Ashwood after the Hollow Star's recruiters.

steps.text: Hear Old Wynn out at the Drowned Lantern
Track Tamsin through the Ashwood
Find the recruiters' camp: bring Tamsin home, or let her choose

quests.title: The Mill at Night
quests.summary: Shadows move inside Varrow's Mill like a family sitting down to dinner.

steps.text: Investigate Varrow's Mill after dark
Drive out the shadows
Find Lysa Varrow's locket and lay her ghost to rest

quests.title: The Goblin Who Stayed
quests.summary: A goblin scout named Wix owes you his life, and he has opinions about pie.

steps.text: Spare the goblin scout on the road
Settle the matter of the stolen pies with Brannoc
Bring Wix's clan luck-stone out of the warren

quests.title: The Hollow Star
quests.summary: The Marsh of Chelimber is steaming in midwinter. The Grey Company and the Hollow Star are both after the second shard.

steps.text: Cross the Grayflow at the Grey Company's toll bridge (F8)
Get through the lizardfolk hunting grounds (F9)
Find out what happened in Drowned Marrowmere (F10)
Clear the Marrowmere chapel (F11)
Find the 'friend in Ashford Hall'
Decide Mayor Tarrow's fate (F12)
Break into the abbey cloister (F13)
Face Sister Venna in the abbey undercroft (F14)
Read the abbey archives

quests.title: Mother Sallow's Bargain
quests.summary: A kindly old woman in the bog knows what the crown really is. Her price is something precious.

steps.text: Find Mother Sallow's hut through the wisp-lit bog
Strike her bargain, or break it

quests.title: Deserters' Bounty
quests.summary: The Lantern Board offers a bounty on 'bandits' in the Forgotten Forest. Captain Kell is paying it.

steps.text: Track the 'bandits'
Free them, or turn them in

quests.title: The Fallen Paladin's Shield
quests.summary: The abbey's founder carried a shield blessed by the Morninglord. It went down into the flooded crypt with her.

steps.text: Find the clue in the abbey chapel
Search the flooded crypt
Restore the shield at the shrine

quests.title: Edric's Errand
quests.summary: Edric wants to prove himself: shadow the mayor's runner and steal the Hall ledger.

steps.text: Shadow the mayor's runner
Steal the Hall ledger
Survive Venna's enforcers

quests.title: The King's Kiln
quests.summary: Maelis has gone to the King's Kiln with the last shard. She means to put the crown on.

steps.text: Ash is falling on Ashford
Get through Ashfall Pass (F15)
Break through the Kiln Gate (F16)
Open the gate's lock
Cross the Furnace Halls (F17)
Break the Kiln's first seal
Pass Ser Ida and the Honor Guard (F18)
Cross the Ember Galleries (F19)
Break the Hollow Star's last stand (F20)
Stop the Crowning

quests.title: The Cold Forge
quests.summary: King Varrow's own forge lies cold beyond the lava tubes. A shard could relight it, if you can stand its whisper.

steps.text: Find the forge through the lava tubes
Relight the forge and quench a weapon

quests.title: Ser Ida's Unfinished Oath
quests.summary: Ser Ida Marrow swore to see King Varrow buried. She never did.

steps.text: Hear Ser Ida's oath
Search the ossuary
Lay King Varrow's remains to rest

quests.title: Last Boats from Ashford
quests.summary: Ashford is leaving by river. Brannoc is not.

steps.text: Escort the evacuation convoy
Brannoc's choice: leave the inn, or defend it

quests.title: Wix's Homecoming
quests.summary: Wix's clan lives in the upper caves. Something big is sitting on their doorstep.

steps.text: Meet Wix's clan
Deal with the giant at their door

quests.title: Bounty: Stirges at the Mill Pond
quests.summary: The Hall pays for the bloodsuckers nesting in the reeds by Varrow's Mill.

steps.text: Clear the stirges by the mill pond
Collect the bounty at the town hall

quests.title: Bounty: Bandits on the River Road
quests.summary: Five robbers have been stopping carts on the Ashwood track.

steps.text: Deal with the bandits on the Ashwood track
Collect the bounty at the town hall

quests.title: Bounty: The Goat-Taker
quests.summary: A griffon has been carrying off goats from the hills above the old mine.

steps.text: Drive off the griffon in the hills above the mine
Collect the bounty at the town hall

quests.title: Bounty: Spiders in the Reeds
quests.summary: Giant spiders are webbing the marsh paths the lizardfolk hunt on.

steps.text: Burn out the spiders in the hunting grounds
Collect the bounty at the town hall

quests.title: Bounty: The Causeway Ghouls
quests.summary: Two ghouls stalk the causeway into Marrowmere after dark.

steps.text: Put down the ghouls on the Marrowmere causeway
Collect the bounty at the town hall

quests.title: Bounty: Owlbear on the Goat Track
quests.summary: An owlbear, driven down by the heat, has the pass road to itself.

steps.text: Deal with the owlbear in Ashfall Pass
Collect the bounty at the town hall

quests.title: Bounty: The Troll at the Forge Bridge
quests.summary: A troll has taken the old bridge below the Great Forge and eats whoever crosses.

steps.text: Kill the troll below the Great Forge (fire or acid finishes it)
Collect the bounty at the town hall

quests.title: The Smuggler's Note
quests.summary: A note in a buried satchel: 'Rest under the third millstone.'

steps.text: Find what the smuggler buried in the Ashwood
Look under the third millstone at Varrow's Mill

quests.title: The Sergeant's Key
quests.summary: A drowned Grey Company sergeant carried a key tagged 'Marrowmere chapel, strongbox'.

steps.text: Search the drowned sergeant in the reeds
Find the strongbox in Marrowmere

quests.title: The Kiln-Wardens' Strongroom
quests.summary: An Ammarindar rune-stone names a strongroom near the Great Forge.

steps.text: Read the rune-stone in Ashfall Pass
Open the Kiln-Wardens' strongroom at the Great Forge
